title: Po Yan Oblate PS, P.1 dictation syllabus 2021-22 (2nd sem) - A. Sentences
licence: Public school web document (c) the school; used only as a read-only evaluation fixture, short excerpt, not for redistribution.
raw_text:
A. Sentences 80%

1. How many mangoes are there?

2. There are seventeen mangoes.

3. He is reading under the tree.

4. She is sleeping.

5. What colour is the T-shirt?

6. It is brown.

7. I can smell some flowers.

8. I can hear a dog.

9. I can touch a cat.

10. Their shoes are white.

11. Can a parrot fly?

12. No, they cannot.

13. My pet has pink eyes.
